== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ラッキー・ショット</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">戦闘用ビークルを目標として起動している場合に、武器運命数にXを加える。実際に武器運命数を引く前に使用すること。ユーズド：X＝1。ロスト：X＝3。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">AT－ATの装甲に歩兵用火器は通用しないが、ごく稀にブラスターの光弾が装甲板の隙間を貫くこともある。非常に分の悪い賭だが、反乱軍にとってはいつものことだ。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Lucky Shot.

'''Lore''' — Infantry weapons cannot pierce AT-AT armor, but a blaster bolt rarely hits a gap in the plating. It is a very poor bet, but such odds are nothing new for the Rebellion.

'''Game text''' — When activating a weapon targeting a combat vehicle, add X to the weapon destiny. Use this before the weapon destiny is drawn. Used: X equals 1. Lost: X equals 3.

Lore calls it a very poor bet rather than one shot in a million. Game text uses 起動する for targeting and writes USED/LOST as ユーズド／ロスト.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-luckyshot.gif|Original English face]], [[Lucky Shot]].</ref>
